rationale: No candidate plausibly supplied a concrete, material drafting template for the child. C10 is strongest because it is an Eisenhower letter to Congress transmitting the product of a detailed federal study and urging action, but its language and administrative sequence are not substantially shared with the Mission 66 letter. C13 similarly discusses a federal program, appropriations, and future budget submissions, while C25 links preservation of a national historic property to an appropriation request. These are generic similarities in congressional and budget communication rather than distinctive shared drafting or machinery. The national-monument proclamations concern the National Park Service but use an entirely different legal form and operative structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: They have just completed a thorough study of the present and future needs of the National Park System and have prepared a comprehensive, ten-year plan
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The report is the result of a detailed study of our water problems and of the present powers and activities of the various Federal establishments
shared_material.explanation: C10 shares the general study-to-report pattern, but not distinctive language, sequencing, or the same administrative machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There will shortly be transmitted to the Congress an amendment of the 1957 Budget
shared_material.parent_excerpt: you can count on our recommending additional funds for this purpose in the 1957 budget
shared_material.explanation: C13 shares prospective 1957 budget language, but this is routine budgetary communication and does not establish template reuse.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is the responsibility of the Federal Government to preserve them
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am in favor of preserving our outstanding historical structures
shared_material.explanation: C25 shares a preservation rationale followed by a funding request, but the objects, factual development, and drafting structure differ materially.
